map.根据体重、活动水平和训练目标，估算每日蛋白质摄入范围。: Estimate the recommended daily protein intake range from body weight, activity level and training goal.
map.每日蛋白质需求：按体重与目标取系数——久坐 0.8 至 1.0、规律训练 1.4: Daily protein requirement: pick a factor from body weight and goal — sedentary 0.8 to 1.0, regular training 1.4 to 2.0, muscle gain 1.6 to 2.2, muscle-preserving fat loss 1.8 to 2.4 g/kg — and multiply to get the recommended daily intake range.
map.健身人群按体重与训练量确定每日蛋白质摄入范围。: Determine your daily protein intake range from body weight and training volume.
map.减脂期提高系数保肌（目标+0.2），增肌期同理。: Raise the factor by +0.2 to preserve muscle during fat loss (and likewise for muscle gain).
map.把克数换算成食物份数（鸡蛋/鸡胸），便于日常执行。: Convert grams into food portions (eggs / chicken breast) to make it easy to follow day to day.
map.可复现算例：70 kg 规律训练者蛋白需求: Reproducible example: protein needs of a 70 kg regular trainee
map.输入：体重 70 kg、活动量「规律训练」1.6 g/kg、目标「增肌」+0.2:
Input: body weight 70 kg, activity level "Regular training" 1.6 g/kg, goal "Muscle gain" +0.2.
Factor factor=1.6+0.2=1.8 g/kg; lower bound minFactor=max(0.8, 1.8−0.2)=1.6, upper bound maxFactor=1.8+0.2=2.0.
Daily protein range=70×1.6 ~ 70×2.0 = 112–140 g.
Roughly equivalent to 112/6≈19 ~ 140/6≈23 eggs' worth of protein (about 6 g per egg), or 112/30≈4 ~ 140/30≈5 servings of chicken breast (about 30 g protein each).
map.蛋白系数怎么选？: How do I choose the protein factor?
map.久坐 0.8、轻度 1.0、中度 1.3、规律训练 1.6、高强度/增肌 2.0: Sedentary 0.8, light 1.0, moderate 1.3, regular training 1.6, high intensity / muscle gain 2.0 g/kg; add +0.2 for muscle-preserving fat loss or muscle gain. This tool gives a range rather than a fixed value, so you can fine-tune it to your training volume that day.
map.健康人群高蛋白通常安全，但肾功能不全者需限蛋白；蛋白本身不直接致胖（1g≈4kc: High protein is generally safe for healthy people, but those with impaired kidney function need to limit protein. Protein itself does not directly cause weight gain (1 g ≈ 4 kcal); excess gives no extra muscle-building benefit and instead adds metabolic and fluid-intake burden. Prefer getting it from whole foods.
map.留空使用推荐值: Leave blank to use the recommended value
